name: country_demonyms
description: Map a country name to its standard English nationality adjective, with a matched adjective-copy control.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
pairs=[('France','French'),('Germany','German'),('Italy','Italian'),('Spain','Spanish'),('Portugal','Portuguese'),('Britain','British'),('Ireland','Irish'),('Scotland','Scottish'),('Wales','Welsh'),('England','English'),('Canada','Canadian'),('Australia','Australian'),('New Zealand','New Zealand'),('Japan','Japanese'),('China','Chinese'),('Korea','Korean'),('India','Indian'),('Pakistan','Pakistani'),('Brazil','Brazilian'),('Argentina','Argentine'),('Mexico','Mexican'),('Chile','Chilean'),('Peru','Peruvian'),('Colombia','Colombian'),('Egypt','Egyptian'),('Kenya','Kenyan'),('Nigeria','Nigerian'),('Ghana','Ghanaian'),('Morocco','Moroccan'),('Turkey','Turkish'),('Greece','Greek'),('Poland','Polish'),('Sweden','Swedish'),('Norway','Norwegian'),('Denmark','Danish'),('Finland','Finnish'),('Austria','Austrian'),('Switzerland','Swiss'),('Netherlands','Dutch'),('Belgium','Belgian')]
items=[];control=[]
for r in range(2):
 for country,adj in pairs:
  p=f'Country: {country}. English nationality adjective:' if r==0 else f'Complete the nationality adjective. A citizen of {country} is'
  items.append({'prompt':p,'answer':' '+adj});control.append({'prompt':f'Copy the nationality adjective. Country: {country}; adjective: {adj}. Adjective:','answer':' '+adj})
random.shuffle(items);random.shuffle(control)
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
